```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)

# read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# filter to a state you are interested in
louisiana <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "LA") 
```

```{r}
cancer <- louisiana %>%
  dplyr::filter(CANCER >= 50) 
```

```{r}
# filter to a county you are interested in
river_parish <- louisiana %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Ascension Parish", "St. Charles Parish", "St. James Parish", "St. John the Baptist Parish")) 

# find the average values for all variables within counties
louis_counties <- aggregate(louisiana, by = list(louisiana$CNTY_NAME), FUN = mean) |> 
    rename(County_Label = Group.1)
```

```{r}
library(stars)
library(tmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridisLite)

tm_shape(louis_counties) + 
    tm_graticules() + 
    tm_fill(
        col = "PEOPCOLORPCT",
        palette = 'cividis'
        ) +
    tm_borders(
        ) +
tm_shape(cancer) +
    tm_dots(
        col ="CANCER",
        palette = "red",
        )
```

```{r}
tm_shape(river_parish) +
    tm_fill(
        col = "CANCER",
        palette = 'cividis'
    ) +
    tm_borders(
        lwd = 0.5,
        lty = "dashed"
    )

```
